title: Amputate
summary: AM'PUTATE, verb transitive [Latin amputo, of amb, about, and puto, to prune.] 1. To prune branches of trees or vines; to cut off. 2. To cut off a limb or other part of an animal body; a term of surger

inlines.v: AM'PUTATE, verb transitive [Latin amputo, of amb, about, and puto, to prune.] 1. To prune branches of trees or vines; to cut off. 2. To cut off a limb or other part of an animal body; a term of surgery.
